title: A Lightless Cell
summary: A stone room with no door and no light, where Layla wakes.
inspect_text: Cold stone closes in on every side. The air is stale and still. You can feel a wall at the edge of the dark — worked stone, smooth and seamless, with no door, no grate, no crack of light. When you run your fingers along it you find the faintest seam, like a line scored into a board before a stone is played. The room has edges. Somewhere, it has a way out.

features.label: seam in the stone wall
features.inspect_text: The stone here is scored by a hairline seam, straight as a ruled line. It could be the work of a door, a panel, or a board that has not yet been played.
